result.summary: The image shows an overall clean interface, but there are a few layout and alignment inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name at the top right is partially obscured or cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container width or truncate the name more gracefully to prevent it from clipping.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section has inconsistent spacing compared to other sections, and the heart icon on the image might be too close to the edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase padding or margins to ensure UI elements are not crowding the image borders.
